source: github.com/vmware/vcf-api-specs — specifications/vcf-operations/vcf-operations-openapi.json (VMware Cloud Foundation Operations API 9.1.0.0), the same repo the fleet subset was seeded from.
note: The FULL 9.x operation index. Until now only a 7-path fleet subset was seeded, so the conformance gate that guards against 踩坑 #36 could not see any 9.x path outside Fleet — a hallucinated 9.x endpoint would have passed. Kept alongside the 8.6 index rather than replacing it: this skill supports both, and a path present in one and absent in the other is exactly the fact a caller needs.
